name: Feeble Skeleton
description: Fragile bones clattering in the cold wind of the Spire base.

name: Spire Imp
description: Cackling creature with obsidian claws that leaps from rafters.

name: Crypt Ghoul
description: Feral flesh-eating scavenger that feasts upon fallen adventurers.

name: Tormented Shade
description: Spectral phantom weaving between planes, ignoring physical defense.

name: Hollow Knight
description: Suit of rusted gothic plate armor propelled by malevolent spirits.

name: Blood Cultist Zealot
description: Robed acolyte offering dark incantations and sacrificing vitality for power.

name: Obsidian Sentry Gargoyle
description: Living stone guardian perched atop high buttresses, deflecting blows.

name: Rotting Plague Abomination
description: Bloated necrotic juggernaut dripping foul bile and toxic pustules.

name: Gargoyle Overseer Malgorath
description: Colossal stone monstrosity perched atop the 10th tier threshold. Summons shockwaves.

name: Cursed Inquisitor
description: Fallen templar purging all trespassers with blackened sacred fire.

name: Spire Headsman
description: Immense hooded brute swinging a guillotine-sized executioner axe.

name: Crypt Arch-Lich
description: Ancient sorcerer defying death with unholy blood phylacteries.

name: The Flesh Amalgam of Sorrow
description: Writhing mass of stitched bodies and wailing faces that secretes virulent venom.

name: Eldritch Void Stalker
description: Creature from the depths between worlds that blinks across space.

name: Infernal Dreadnought
description: Animated molten iron fortress burning with unquenchable hellfire.

name: Valthor the Soul Extinguisher
description: The immortal architect of the Grim Spire, sovereign ruler of death.
